title.orig: An Act Declaring April 16 of Every Year a Special Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the City of Marikina in Commemoration of Its Founding Anniversary to Be Known as "Marikina City Day"
title.th: วันเมือง Marikina

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10788_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: April 16 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday and no class day is schools in the City of Marikina in commemoration of its founding anniversary to be known as "Marikina City Day".
For work performed on special working holiday an employee is entitled to his/her regular wage.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
